Welcome to Lofoten Arctic Lodge (no. 14) in Lofoten! A modern 103 m² lodge where comfort meets the wild beauty of Lofoten. Built to high Scandinavian standards, it features a private jacuzzi, sauna, and panoramic ocean views.

Set at the end of the road, this is one of the more private lodges in Lyngvær. Elevated in the terrain, it offers sweeping 180-degree sea views and quiet seclusion.

This upgraded lodge includes a larger terrace, an EV charger (included) and full floor heating for convenient, year-round stays. The lodge boasts a fully equipped American-style kitchen with top-notch appliances, including an induction cooktop, dishwasher, filter coffee machine, and all the kitchenware you'll need to prepare delicious meals. Enjoy the convenience of a washing machine and dryer, making your stay both comfortable and practical.

Spacious and thoughtfully designed with two bathrooms, both with big showers, it accommodates up to 8 guests and blends modern comfort with the raw beauty of Lofoten. Whether you’re chasing the Northern Lights, exploring fjords, playing a round of golf at Lofoten Links under the midnight sun, or simply unwinding in quiet comfort — this is your base for it all. 

Located just 20 minutes from Svolvær and the airport, and 12 minutes from Henningsvær, it sits close to Lofoten’s finest hiking trails, fishing spots, white-sand beaches, and kayaking routes.

This property is managed by Lyngvær Lodges.
